name: Hebbal–Silk Board Twin Tunnel Road
scope: 16.74 km underground twin-tunnel road from Hebbal (Esteem Mall Junction) to Silk Board (KSRP Junction), with intermediate ramps at Mekri Circle, Race Course and Lalbagh; split into two construction packages
pending: Adani Group's lowest (L1) bid of ₹22,267 crore came in about 24% over estimate for the first package and 28% over for the second (package-level cost split not disclosed in the source used here). Cabinet decision on whether to accept the bid remained pending as of 2026-08-26.
notes: First B-SMILE (Bengaluru Smart Infrastructure Limited) record on this site — a special-purpose vehicle with jurisdiction over Bengaluru Urban district for large infrastructure (tunnel roads, flyovers, underpasses, stormwater-drain-buffer-zone roads), reportedly launched around 2025-05-05. This is also the exact bid-vs-estimate pairing the site's own build spec cites as a model of P5-compliant, fact-only reporting ("lowest bid was ₹22,267 crore against an estimate of ₹17,698 crore") — state the figures, no characterisation of why the gap exists. Corporation set to Central as a placeholder — the corridor runs from North Bengaluru (Hebbal) to South (Silk Board); not yet mapped to wards.
